cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Take the Consequence
cards.instruction: Get them to accept responsibility for carrying out the cost, penalty, or unpleasant next step.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. You said you'd announce the budget cut if your plan cost more.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Then the announcement can be slightly apologetic.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I could. But the bargain gave you this development opportunity.

mechanism: A corrects how an overrun is described and coaches the announcement while making B personally deliver the agreed bad news.
confusable: D181 diffuses own blame; D197 assigns B the concrete cost-bearing next step.
comparison: Public announcement and ownership differ from private chores.
seedUse: Keep B offering A's superior explanation as a trap the Stance can accept without taking over delivery.
